# NorthSide GTA

NorthSide GTA is a real estate and community-information website covering seven communities north of Toronto.
The site is operated by Finally Home Agents.

## Communities

- Aurora: York Region community with established neighbourhoods, parks, GO Transit, and Highway 404 access.
  https://northsidegta.ca/communities/aurora
- Newmarket: York Region community centred on Main Street, Southlake Regional Health Centre, GO Transit, and local amenities.
  https://northsidegta.ca/communities/newmarket
- Whitchurch-Stouffville: York Region community combining Stouffville's urban area, rural land, Main Street, and GO Transit.
  https://northsidegta.ca/communities/stouffville
- Uxbridge: Durham Region township known for trails, rural landscapes, its historic downtown, and an equestrian community.
  https://northsidegta.ca/communities/uxbridge
- Georgina: York Region municipality on Lake Simcoe that includes Keswick, Sutton, Jackson's Point, and Pefferlaw.
  https://northsidegta.ca/communities/georgina
- East Gwillimbury: York Region municipality that includes Holland Landing, Sharon, Queensville, and Mount Albert.
  https://northsidegta.ca/communities/east-gwillimbury
- Scugog: Durham Region township centred on Port Perry and Lake Scugog, with rural and waterfront communities.
  https://northsidegta.ca/communities/scugog

## Organization

They work with HomeLife Optimum Realty, Brokerage.
Ontario real estate registration is regulated by the Real Estate Council of Ontario (RECO).
